# 触发 complete_mission / required_missions 的四种情况
# 本文件不含任何游戏素材。

namespace = zz_mission_test

country_event = {
	id = zz_mission_test.1
	title = "zz_mission_test.1.t"
	desc = "zz_mission_test.1.d"
	is_triggered_only = yes
	immediate = {
		# ① 引用已定义的任务 → 不应报
		complete_mission = zz_mission_ok
		# ② 引用不存在的任务 → info
		complete_mission = zz_mission_missing
	}
	option = {
		name = "zz_mission_test.1.a"
	}
}
